shared_elements: carved stone surface with incised linear detail
anthropomorphic figure with rendered face and hair/headdress
horizontal band/belt-like element across the body
low-relief patterning suggesting garment or feather texture
justification: Both are stone carvings of an anthropomorphic figure whose body is covered with incised detail, including roundel/disc motifs and a horizontal band crossing the torso, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a flat, finely incised profile relief filling a rectangular panel with plant-like rosette motifs, while B is a weathered, blocky frontal free-standing sculpture with coarse, shallow markings and no comparable composition.
